title: Reading Corso's The Day After Roswell

tellings.quote: I started rereading I read the the uh Corsos uh day after Roswell uhuh and I really started digging in that was a little after that was 97

plain: John Blitch, a scientist who worked for the Pentagon's advanced research agency and says he was once abducted by an alien, says that around 1997 he began reading The Day After Roswell and "really started digging in." The book was published in 1997 by Philip J. Corso, a retired Army officer, and is about the reported 1947 crash of an unknown craft near Roswell, New Mexico. Blitch tells it as the point where his own research into the subject began.
